title: DlqEnvelope
description: Envelope for a record rastreo quarantined to a dead-letter destination after primary delivery failed. The transport carries a set of `x-rastreo-*` headers (Kafka record headers or NATS message headers) alongside the payload, which is a single unmodified `device-record-v1`. Consumers filter and triage on the headers without parsing the payload.

headers.description: Transport headers attached to every DLQ message. Present only when the sink's dead-letter config has `include_error_metadata: true` (the default).

x-rastreo-source-topic.description: Kafka: the primary topic the record failed to reach. Mutually exclusive with `x-rastreo-source-subject`.

x-rastreo-source-subject.description: NATS: the primary subject the record failed to reach. Mutually exclusive with `x-rastreo-source-topic`.

x-rastreo-error-class.description: The class of the failure that quarantined the record, set at the failure site. Kafka DLQ records carry `produce_failure`; NATS DLQ records carry `publish_failure` or `ack_rejection` depending on which stage failed.

x-rastreo-dlq-timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the record was written to the dead-letter destination.

payload.description: The unmodified `DeviceRecord` that failed primary delivery.
